verdict.rationale: Gusto ships an official 'Embedded Dev Assistant' MCP server that lets AI coding tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop) interact directly with the Embedded Payroll API and documentation, which is the closest evidence to natural-language operability, but this is aimed at developers building integrations rather than end-users issuing natural-language commands to run payroll tasks directly. Missing for 10: evidence of an end-user-facing natural-language interface for actually executing payroll/HR actions (not just API/doc assistance for developers), and independent hands-on verification of the MCP server's capabilities.
